answer_1.quote: We also adopt LongBench to further evaluate the long-context generation performance of our method and the baselines. We choose eight subsets from four different task types in LongBench as our practical datasets. They are single document QA task (Qasper), summarization task (QMSum, MultiNews), few-shot learning task (TREC, TriviQA, SAMSum), and code completion task (LCC, RepoBench-P).
answer_1.outputs: Generated text for language modeling (perplexity), QA answers, summaries, few-shot responses, and code snippets

answer_2.quote: We benchmark MoQAE on six widely-used open-source models... To assess performance, we evaluate the perplexity of MoQAE on the WikiText2 dataset. ... F1 score is used as the evaluation metric for Qasper and Trivi‑QA, while ROUGE score is used for QMSum, and MultiNews, and similarity score is used for LCC and RepoBench‑P.
